subtitle:2:1011091001:.text: So he's running the show? You were able to save him, I see.
subtitle:2:1011091001:.source_cn: 他就是这次的负责人吗？被你们救出来了啊

subtitle:2:1011091002:.text: Yes, my lady. My apologies, I never intended for this eyesore to end up in your presence.
subtitle:2:1011091002:.source_cn: 是，尊贵的女士。很抱歉……让这坨垃圾污染了您的眼睛

subtitle:2:1011091003:.text: I will remove him from your sight at once.

subtitle:2:1011091004:.text: No, please! I beg you! Give me one more chance.
subtitle:2:1011091004:.source_cn: 不、不，求求您，再给我个机会，我一定、一定会——

subtitle:2:1011091006:.text: Yes! Yes! Just one last chance... I will not disappoint you, my lady!
subtitle:2:1011091006:.source_cn: 是、是！我……卑职……小的，小的一定不会让您失望，一定！

subtitle:2:1011091007:.text: *Laugh*... I hope not... for your sake.
subtitle:2:1011091007:.source_cn: 呵呵呵呵呵，既然如此，就试试看吧

subtitle:2:1011091008:.text: My lady... Pardon me, but I've seen you kill for less.
subtitle:2:1011091008:.source_cn: 女士……那家伙可是搞砸了，你竟如此宽容……

subtitle:2:1011091009:.text: He did help us with our little problem, so it wasn't a total failure on his part.
subtitle:2:1011091009:.source_cn: 毕竟他也帮我们唤出了“那东西”，也不算完全搞砸了嘛

subtitle:2:1011091010:.text: I'll give him one last chance.
subtitle:2:1011091010:.source_cn: 一次机会，就当做小小的奖励吧
